problem: Canonical daily blog publication PRs were blocked by the engineering integration bundle because repository learning/ledger/docs were required even though the publication obligation and lineage already live canonically in Supabase.
root_cause: The closure compiler classified every material repository delta identically and had no explicit runtime-closure authority for content-publication obligations.
failed_approach: Require engineering writeback artifacts for generated publication output, creating a second truth and blocking protected merge.
fix: Add an explicit policy allowlist for canonical runtime-closure obligation prefixes.
Only content-publication:* is runtime-closed; ordinary material code/config changes still require repository learning, ledger and human documentation.
Expose closure authority in the immutable integration bundle.
Regression-test generated blog scope as material but closed by canonical-runtime-obligation.
